status: Proposed book-only wording changes for John’s review
scope: Make liming conditional on a soil test; retain crop preferences, pH values and disease cautions. No canonical records or approved source files are changed.

asparagus.before: lime very acid ground if needed
asparagus.after: lime only if a soil test shows a need
asparagus.reason: Make the basis for deciding explicit.

bean_broad.before: Lime very acid soil to pH 6.5.
bean_broad.after: About pH 6.5 suits the crop; test before liming.
bean_broad.reason: Keep the pH preference without making it an automatic liming target.

bean_runner.before: Lime acid soil if needed towards pH 6.5.
bean_runner.after: About pH 6.5 suits the crop; test before liming.
bean_runner.reason: Keep the pH preference without automatic treatment.

beetroot.before: Lime acid soil towards pH 6.5; feed poor ground if needed.
beetroot.after: About pH 6.5 suits the crop; test before liming. Feed poor ground if needed.
beetroot.reason: Retain the crop preference and conditional feeding; qualify liming.

broccoli.after: lime only if a soil test shows a need.
broccoli.reason: Make the decision explicit; the clubroot table already says testing is needed and lime is not a cure.

brussels_sprouts.after: Lime only if a soil test shows a need.
brussels_sprouts.reason: Make the decision explicit; retain the separate clubroot caution.

cabbage.before: Add organic matter and lime acid ground only if needed.
cabbage.after: Add organic matter; lime only if a soil test shows a need.
cabbage.reason: Bring the reminder into line with conditional soil advice.
Carry the test requirement into the main instructions.

carrot.before: lime acid soil in winter and prepare a fine seedbed.
carrot.after: test before liming and prepare a fine seedbed.
carrot.reason: Remove the suggestion of a routine winter treatment; retain the approved fresh-manure qualification.

lettuce.reason: Make the reminder an action rather than a blanket warning about acidity.

lettuce.before: Lime if necessary and improve heavy clay with compost.
lettuce.after: Test before adding lime; improve heavy clay with compost.
lettuce.reason: Explain how to decide whether lime is necessary.
Retain the existing preference but require a check before correction.

potato.reason: Make the crop-specific timing clear, rather than imply that a rotation bed can never be limed.

potato.before: Avoid liming; keep soil moist as tubers form.
potato.after: Avoid fresh lime; keep soil moist as tubers form.
potato.reason: Retain the common-scab and moisture caution with clear timing.

radish.reason: Make the test requirement explicit; retain the existing ACID SOIL table entry.
